name: preview-card-2c
title: Preview Card 2c: Split panels
author: tony <tony@spaceman.sh>
description: A catalogue card for showing a live component preview. Two stacked inner panels: the preview has a flat bottom and the footer has a flat top. The card is inset 5px on every side, with the 6px gap and footer background from 1c.
docs: Every preview card design exports the same `PreviewCard` component, so you can switch designs by changing the import path. Pass the live preview as children.
